title: Plugins tell the whole truth; a native menu and folder picker in the Mac app
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's capabilities in a calmer UI; live-check plugins; the native app.
plan: a live session with a plugin on
make the Settings list the whole list of loaded plugins
native menu items and the system folder picker in the Mac app

decisions.decision: turn claude.ai's plugin sync off for DCLab Code's sessions (syncClaudeAiPlugins false in the SDK's flag settings)
decisions.why: synced plugins loaded in every session whatever the sheet said; this run only, nothing moved; a ticked synced plugin still loads as a local folder (checked live)
Claude Code desktop is believed to be a web page in a native window, as DCLab Code is; a second UI adds upkeep, not capability

decisions.decision: the native menu calls only named page actions (window.dclabMenu over a fixed object)
decisions.why: the native side never sends code to the page, only a name

change: dclab-code server/plugins.js (claudeCodeEnabled, ids), server/engine.js (settings), server/app.js (claudeAiSkills, inClaudeCode), web/* (switch, locked plugins, menu hooks, folder picker), mac/main.swift (menu, NSOpenPanel, smoke checks the page script), tests, docs.

findings.scenario: live session s_0bacea12c634: claude-md-management ticked; productivity and data (synced from claude.ai) also loaded
findings.cause: Claude Code loads claude.ai-synced plugins in every session
findings.fix: syncClaudeAiPlugins false per session; a synced plugin loads only when ticked
findings.test: server test of the options; live rerun s_b9a90056c609 loaded exactly the ticked ones

findings.defect: the Mac smoke test passed without the page's script having run
findings.scenario: WebKit reported the page loaded before the module ran; the menu hooks were missing
findings.cause: the smoke checked only the HTML, never the script
findings.fix: the smoke test waits for the page's hooks (up to 10 s) and fails on any page error
findings.test: mac smoke: OK with both hooks and no errors

findings.defect: 'on in Claude Code' read only the user settings
findings.scenario: a project's settings turn a plugin on or off
findings.fix: the label says 'on in your Claude Code user settings'

findings.defect: the plugin warning ran off the sheet
findings.scenario: the longer hint after the sync change

measurements.name: live
measurements.result: two sessions, $0.18; after the fix only the two ticked plugins (one synced) and the person's claude.ai skills

measurements.name: mac smoke
measurements.gate: the app opens, the page's script runs with no error
measurements.result: SMOKE OK, both menu hooks present, no errors

outcome: The Settings sheet's plugin ticks are what loads; the Mac app has a native menu and folder picker.
lessons: Run a settings list live once: the tool may load more than the list says.
A smoke test must prove the script ran, not only that the HTML arrived.
risks: the menu and folder picker were not clicked by hand in the Mac app (the page test calls the same hooks); cloud sessions and a plugin marketplace remain
